title: 지방보조금통합관리망의 관리 및 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
title_original: 지방보조금통합관리망의 관리 및 운영에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 8 (Data Analysis and Utilization)
(1) The Minister of the Interior and Safety may use data accumulated in the Integrated Local Subsidy Management System to conduct analyses to improve the efficiency of local subsidy management and prevent duplicate or fraudulent receipt of subsidies.
(2) The Minister may provide relevant institutions with the results of analyses under paragraph (1).
(3) The Minister may provide information necessary to support the performance of on-site inspections by local governments or relevant institutions.
